ModMetaData.name: Research Reframed
ModMetaData.author: lyj
ModMetaData.description:
A modern, RimWorld-compatible and data-driven redesign of the research interface. The Frontier Atlas theme keeps research state, selection, and search visually distinct. Research projects and tabs added by other mods are discovered automatically.
以“边疆航图”风格重新设计 RimWorld 科技页面，清晰区分研究状态、当前选择与搜索结果。自动读取其他 Mod 添加的标准研究项目与研究标签。
